title: Zesty Brazilian Tod Fritters
description: These briny, pillowy fritters are a delicious and adventurous Brazilian dish, featuring the warm flavor of cinnamon stick and a dairy-free friendly recipe, made with deep-fry tod.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees.
In a large bowl, combine the tod, cinnamon stick powder, onion, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Gradually add the flour to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Using your hands, shape the dough into small balls, about 1 inch in diameter.
Carefully place the balls into the hot oil and fry for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fritters hot and enjoy.
For an extra crispy coating, you can chill the shaped dough balls in the refrigerator for 30 minutes before frying.
To make the fritters extra zesty, you can sprinkle them with a pinch of salt and a squeeze of fresh lime juice before serving.
